system.flavor: A two-shot disposable holdout, favoured for its extreme reliability. A pull tab opens the over/under barrels and activates the permanently-sealed battery. Electrically-fired caseless ammunition in a reinforced carbon-fibre case; non-reloadable.
system.notes:
Interface Magazine Vol.1 Issue 1 p.37 (PDF idx 36) OCR text layer: P 1 J R 454 2 2 VR, $100. The same issue's compiled 'Weapon Specs' table on p.29 (PDF idx 28) prints a variant line - P 1 P P 454 2 2 VR 90 - and a range-damage row for the .454 round: 4D6+3 point/short, 3D6+3 medium, 2D6 long, availability P, suggested cost $50/10.

Damage and range from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.16 (PDF idx 17), which prints it complete: P -2 P R 4D6+3 (.454) 2 1 VR 40M, 100eb - 'the deadliest of the polymer holdouts, famed for its reliability (and rarity)'. Interface's printed WA/conceal/ROF are kept.
